verse.name: v1a
verse.lines: Before the day, before the light, before the world revolved around the sun

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: God on High, stepped down into time and wrote the story of His Love for everyone

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
He has filled our hearts with wonder
So that we always remember

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
You and I are made to worship
You and I are called to love

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines: You and I are forgiven and free

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
When you and I embrace surrender
When you and I choose to believe

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
Then you and I will see
Who we were meant to be

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines: All we are and all we have, is all a gift from God that we receive

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: Brought to life, we open up our eyes, to see the majesty and glory of the King

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Even the rocks cry out
Even the heavens shout

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
At the sound of His Holy Name
So let every voice sing out

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
And let every knee bow down
He is worthy of all our praise
